summary: Cut at 6.6 (round 1: 6.2, round 2: 6.5, Caiman: 7, ship bar: 7.5). This was the last round, and the section grants no extra rounds. Every gate the ring's section names is green, checked against report.json at both builds and against template-gate.json. Two things improved. The crown gutter, with its two roll beads, now runs continuously over the outer palm face (palm.png). The forepaws now have four separate digits each, gripping the coping. The figure is still the same inflated cartoon bulldog: the brow is a capsule bar, the horns and ears are sausages, the claws are straight rods with no hook, and the muzzle and spout are soft blobs. stones.png still shows creases and star-shaped decimation flecks over the brow, cheeks, fangs and paws. The sculpt has 189,134 faces against the at least 450k at 0.003 asked for twice (the target was set to 300k), and the spout lip is still faceted. From above, the 'wings' are two rectangular slabs either side of a row of four or five dorsal knobs. They are not bat wings, and the back reads as a machined block. The perch is still a thin box with three faceted front lancets, and it has no cornice or quatrefoil. Thin posts and dark, unfinished-looking square sockets stand at its back corners (face.png, shoulder.png). At 300 px the hero reads as a cluttered block or robot head on a pedestal, worse than round 2's hero. The face view still says 'beast head with a pipe', and the side-wall arcade still reads as cog teeth. Against Caiman's even, legible density and the Reptilia sheet's finish, this is below the bar. It sits with Corvus (6.6), not with the shipped Arachne and Manticora (7.5). Of round 2's six punch items, one is done (6, the gutter half), two are partly done (2, 6's arcade half) and three are not done (1, 3, 4, 5's arcade lips).
strengths: The subject concept is right and unique in the collection: a single figurative beast crouched on a parapet with a bored spout thrust past the edge. No other Tenebrae ring has this silhouette.
The crown gutter (0.9 mm wide, 0.4 mm deep, with 0.2 mm rolls) now runs continuously round the outer palm face, so the theme reaches the palm (palm.png, reverse.png).
Forepaws now have four separate digits each over the coping (side.png, shoulder.png). This is a clear step up from round 2's mittens.
The 33-bay side-wall arcade under a 0.4 mm string course is clean CAD with crisp outlines in side.png.
Every gate is clean and honestly reported. The wall census reads 0 walls and 0 unresolved at about 345k rays per build, and the reload is identical at both builds.

checklist.item: One theme face to palm, nothing scattered
checklist.reason: The parapet and beast sit at the crown. The gutter with its rolls runs over the whole outer palm face, and the lancet arcade circles both side walls (palm.png, reverse.png, side.png).

checklist.item: Reads as its Gothic subject at 300 px without the caption
checklist.reason: hero-300 now reads as a cluttered blocky head or robot on a pedestal. The brow bar, fang rods and slab wings make a stack of blocks, and 'gargoyle' no longer comes first. face-300 reads as a horned beast head with a pipe in its mouth, which could also be a bull or dragon skull. Nothing at 300 px says Gothic cathedral: the perch is a plain box, and the arcade reads as cog teeth (contact-300).

checklist.item: Figurative motifs have true outlines, with no combing, smearing or stair-steps
checklist.reason: stones.png shows crease lines and star-shaped decimation flecks over the brow, cheek, fangs, paws and muzzle. The spout lip is faceted (a star pattern on the end face). The sculpt has 189,134 faces (decimation [300000, 0.003]) against the at least 450k asked for. The front lancets are still faceted pockets.

checklist.item: Stones in made settings, à jour, coloured as stained glass
checklist.reason: Not applicable. The section specifies no stones, and report.json records 0 reported and 0 previewed.

checklist.item: No flat, blocky or mechanical CAD; forms are sculpted
checklist.reason: The perch is a thin-walled box with no cornice or corbel. The wings are two rectangular slabs (face.png). Thin posts with ball tips and dark square sockets at the perch's back corners look unfinished (face.png, shoulder.png). The sculpt is inflated capsules, not carved stone.

checklist.item: Factory stock keeps its hard wall-to-face angles
checklist.reason: Not applicable: the section calls for a procedural keyed band, and it has crisp moulded edges.

checklist.item: Distinct silhouette; custom heads at least 13 mm; shoulder ornament not cut off before the face
checklist.reason: It is the only figurative crouching beast in Tenebrae. The figure box is 13.3 mm across and stands 13.1 mm over the coping. The shoulder mouldings and gutter run into the perch foot without a break.

checklist.item: Large, medium and small forms; density and legibility at least Caiman's
checklist.reason: The large form (the figure) is there, but the medium forms are all the same rounded capsules, and the small forms are flecks or rod tips, not carving. The band carries only rib lines and an arcade that reads as teeth. Caiman's hero has an even, legible hierarchy of plates, ridges and texture that this ring does not reach.

punch_list.priority: deferred (the ring is cut; for any future restart)
punch_list.zone: Whole sculpt: brow, horns, ears, fangs, claws, muzzle
punch_list.change: Re-carve the figure as stone, not inflated capsules. Cut a hard brow overhanging the sockets by 0.6–0.8 mm. Facet the cheek and snout planes, with 2–3 furrows each side at least 0.3 mm deep. Taper horns and fangs to cones ending at 0.85 mm. Hook each claw over the coping edge. Decimate to at least 450k faces at 0.003 mm, and make the spout lip a revolved CAD tube end.
punch_list.acceptance: stones.png shows unbroken highlights with no creases or star flecks. hero-300 reads 'stone gargoyle' first, not 'cartoon dog', 'block' or 'robot'.

punch_list.zone: Back, y ±1.5 to ±3.5 mm (the slabs in face.png)
punch_list.change: Replace the rectangular slabs with folded bat wings. Give each a forearm bone, a thumb claw, 3–4 finger bones and a scalloped trailing edge, with membranes recessed 0.3–0.5 mm.
punch_list.acceptance: face-300 shows two scalloped wing shapes either side of the spine, and nothing reads as a slab, step or crest.

punch_list.zone: Perch, its back-corner posts and the arcade rib lips
punch_list.change: Build a solid moulded parapet with a two-step cornice (0.8–1.0 mm overhangs over cavetto hollows), a corbel into the band, and a 3 mm blind quatrefoil 0.5–0.7 mm deep on each side face. Remove or finish the thin back-corner posts and the dark square sockets. Round the arcade rib lips to 0.15 mm.
punch_list.acceptance: In hero-300 the perch shows a lit cornice over a shadow band and does not read as a box. No export edge zone is under 0.3 mm, and walls stays [] with 0 unresolved.
